chapters.title: Winter is coming
chapters.summary: An unnatural winter arrives early. Alaric coordinates relief while the valley's supplies and livestock begin to fail.

chapters.title: Attack of the Wolves
chapters.summary: Frost wolves attack River City. Alaric, Vaelor, Brynar, and the River Guard drive them back.

chapters.title: Frozen River
chapters.summary: The frozen river cripples trade and supply. Alaric, Gawain, and Percival conclude the crisis is deliberate and divide responsibilities.

chapters.title: The Winter's Voice
chapters.summary: Freyja reveals herself as Goddess of Winter, claims the valley, and demands loyalty before the next full moon.

chapters.title: The Council
chapters.summary: Representatives of humans, elves, and dragons reject Freyja's rule and authorize resistance. Alaric is chosen to lead the forward expedition.

chapters.title: The Expedition
chapters.summary: The mixed expedition leaves the valley, passes Greystone Pass and the Waterfall of Giants, and reaches the marker of Freyja's realm.

chapters.title: Tundra
chapters.summary: Frost wolves attack the expedition. Their alpha challenges Alaric, who defeats it and forces the pack to withdraw.

chapters.title: Frozen Forest
chapters.summary: Freyja's troops block the route with fortified hills, siege weapons, Viking warriors, and Mountain Giants. Alaric's flanking force destroys the artillery and the expedition wins the battle.

chapters.title: Castle of Ice
chapters.summary: The expedition storms Freyja's castle. Alaric confronts Freyja alone after she separates him from Vaelor and defeats her after a philosophical and physical confrontation.

chapters.title: Spring's Return
chapters.summary: Freyja's winter ends, the river flows again, trade resumes, and the peoples of the valley celebrate their restored freedom.
